definitions.explanation: The work that came immediately before the current one by the same creator or in the same series — the earlier film, novel, game, or album. Used constantly in reviews and promotional writing.

examples.japanese: {前作|ぜんさく}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: It's more interesting than the previous one.

examples.japanese: {前作|ぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ていなくて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a film you can enjoy even without having seen the previous installment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前作|ぜんさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十年後|じゅうねんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: This novel depicts the world ten years after the previous book.

notes:
⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (previous) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work). Always relative to a current work, so it appears where a new release is being compared with what came before.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前作|ぜんさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to follow on from the previous work
- {前作|ぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to surpass the previous work
- {前作|ぜんさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{続編|ぞくへん}→続編：13818_zokuhen⟧: a sequel to the previous work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧: new work — the latest release, seen from the other direction
- ⟦{代表作|だいひょうさく}→代表作：09952_daihyousaku⟧: representative work — the piece a creator is best known for
- ⟦{続編|ぞくへん}→続編：13818_zokuhen⟧: sequel — the work that follows, not the one that precedes
